You've got a pile of branches in the yard. Maybe from a storm, maybe from a weekend of trimming, maybe from a tree that came down months ago and you've been meaning to deal with it. Either way, it's not going to fit in the city bin.

A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service provides brush chipping across the Omaha metro area. We bring a commercial chipper to your property, feed everything through it, and either leave the chips for your use or haul them away. The pile disappears and your yard is clean.

What We Chip

Storm Debris

Branches and limbs scattered across the yard after a storm. We gather everything, chip it, and leave your yard clean.

Trimming Debris

Branches from tree trimming or shrub pruning that are too big for the city yard waste bin. We chip them down to nothing.

Brush Piles

Accumulated brush from clearing, cleanup, or just years of tossing branches in the corner of the yard. We chip the entire pile in one visit.

Small Logs and Limbs

Our commercial chipper handles branches and limbs up to 12 inches in diameter. Anything larger gets cut into sections and hauled away separately.

What Happens to the Chips

Wood chips make excellent mulch for garden beds, around trees, and on pathways. If you want the chips, we'll blow them right into your beds or leave them in a pile wherever you want. If you don't want them, we haul them away — no extra charge.

Chipping is also the most efficient way to deal with large volumes of brush. A truck-sized pile of branches turns into a fraction of that volume once it goes through the chipper. That means less hauling, less landfill waste, and a cleaner result for your property.

When to Call for Brush Chipping

If you've got more brush than your city yard waste bin can handle, it's time to call. The city of Omaha picks up bundled branches, but there are size limits and it can take weeks. We show up, chip everything in one visit, and you're done.

Brush chipping pairs well with our other services. If you're having trees trimmed, shrubs shaped, or a lot cleared, the chipping is already part of the process. But if you just have a brush pile that needs to go, we'll come out for that too.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does brush chipping cost?

It depends on the volume of brush and how accessible it is. Small piles are quick and affordable. Larger jobs take more time. We give free estimates so you know the price before we start.

Can you chip branches of any size?

Our commercial chipper handles branches up to about 12 inches in diameter. Anything larger gets cut into sections and hauled away. Trunk wood that's too big for the chipper can be bucked into firewood rounds if you want to keep it.

Do I need to pile the brush up before you come?

It helps, but it's not required. If the brush is scattered across the yard, we'll gather it as part of the job. Having it in a pile just speeds things up.

Can I keep the wood chips?

Absolutely. We can spread them in your garden beds, blow them around trees, or leave them in a pile for you to use. If you don't want them, we haul them away at no extra charge.
